text: Now that I have had it for a short time ,I would not buy it again.. Easy to use, but doesn't have an off and on switch.  Some times chunks of cooked waffles get stuck. Sometimes when making a second or third waffle the ready light doesn't work properly. For a waffle "once in a while this is good but for everyday use for two or more people try another option.

product_metadata.title: BELLA Classic Rotating Belgian Waffle Maker with Nonstick Plates, Removable Drip Tray, Adjustable Browning Control and Cool Touch Handles, Black
features: VERSATILE COOKING: With 3 different non-stick coatings, from traditional to ceramic titanium, this waffle iron allows you to cook up a variety of scrumptious treats beyond just waffles. From pancakes to hash browns, let your culinary creativity soar!

FAMILY-SIZED DELIGHT: The large capacity of this rotating waffle maker ensures that you can make plenty of delicious Belgian waffles to feed your family and guests. Start your morning with a hot, fresh batch of perfectly golden, fluffy deliciousness!

FLIPPING PERFECT: The rotating function of this double waffle maker guarantees even cooking and with 9 browning control settings you're sure to get the dessert of your dreams every time. Plus, the cool-touch handle makes flipping a breeze

EASY CLEANUP: Say goodbye to messy batter and hello to easy cleanup with smooth auto-lock cooking surfaces and a dishwasher safe removable drip tray. The non-slip feet keep our waffle irons securely in place, protecting your countertop from any spills

ELEGANT & COMPACT: The sleek design and folding handle make our cute waffle makers the perfect fit for any kitchen decor, plus the compact size makes them easy to store away. They're also a great gift idea and a nice addition to your wedding registry
description: Making Belgian waffles has never been easier with the BELLA rotating waffle maker. The waffle maker's rotating function and browning control knob ensure even and controlled cooking while the non-stick plates and removable drip tray allow for easy cleaning.
